title: APG: Agentic Static-Analysis Infrastructure on LLVM-IR Graph Databases
title_zh: APG：基于LLVM-IR图数据库的智能体式静态分析基础设施

paragraphs.en: APG提供基于LLVM-IR图数据库的38项原子分析能力供LLM智能体编排，提升修复成功率并降低token消耗。 LLM-based coding agents increasingly rely on external program knowledge, yet access to static-analysis graphs alone does not ensure appropriate operation selection or evidence interpretation. We present APG, an infrastructure for semantics-grounded static program analysis. Built on SVF and LLVM, it decomposes compiler-derived program analyses into atomic capabilities that LLM agents can select, compose, and orchestrate for goal-directed, cross-graph investigation, with query safeguards and evidence traces preserving inspectable results and provenance. APG provides 38 atomic capabilities. On analysis requests arising during benchmark repair runs, 35 achieve first-attempt query-generation success rates above 50%, including 13 at 100%. Evaluation on 812 C/C++ defects shows higher repair success than the evaluated baselines. Compared with Passive Graph Push, APG improves first-iteration repair success by 17.6 and 18.0 percentage points on the two benchmark collections and reduces average LLM input-token consumption by 90.8%. Our tool is available at https://github.com/JasonZhongZexin/APG-ICSE-Demo and its demonstration video at https://youtu.be/vkuExZUjGnw
paragraphs.zh: APG提供基于LLVM-IR图数据库的38项原子分析能力供LLM智能体编排，提升修复成功率并降低token消耗。基于LLM的编码智能体日益依赖外部程序知识，然而仅访问静态分析图并不能保证恰当的操作选择或证据解读。 我们提出了APG，一种以语义为基础的静态程序分析基础设施。 它构建于SVF和LLVM之上，将编译器导出的程序分析分解为原子能力，供LLM智能体选择、组合与编排，以进行面向目标、跨图的调查，并通过查询防护与证据追踪保留可查验的结果与来源。 APG提供38项原子能力。 在基准修复运行中产生的分析请求上，35项能力的首次查询生成成功率超过50%，其中13项达到100%。 在812个C/C++缺陷上的评估显示，其修复成功率高于所评估的基线方法。 与Passive Graph Push相比，APG在两个基准集合上将首次迭代修复成功率分别提升17.6和18.0个百分点，并将平均LLM输入token消耗降低90.8%。 我们的工具可在https://github.com/JasonZhongZexin/APG-ICSE-Demo获取，演示视频见https://youtu.be/vkuExZUjGnw。
